# Button group (`button-group`)

Joined buttons, a toolbar segment.

Group: Actions. Styles: `import '@mosaic-home/design-system/css/actions';` (or `style.css`).

## Web API

`createButtonGroup` (types in `dist/web/actions/buttonGroup.d.ts`): `.mh-button-group` (`--tonal`, `--vertical`, `--block`): buttons joined into one segment, each a `.mh-button` with `.mh-button-group__item` (`--icon` when icon-only). `role="group"`, or `role="toolbar"` with a roving tab stop. Toggle items carry `aria-pressed`.

```ts
export function createButtonGroup(options: ButtonGroupOptions): ButtonGroupHandle;

export interface ButtonGroupOptions {
  items: readonly ButtonGroupItem[];
  /** Accessible name of the group, e.g. "Text style" or "Playback". */
  label?: string;
  variant?: ButtonGroupVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  orientation?: ButtonGroupOrientation;
  /** A toolbar: one tab stop, arrow keys (and Home / End) move between the buttons. */
  toolbar?: boolean;
  /** Stretch across the container, buttons sharing the width. */
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  onClick?: (id: string, event: MouseEvent) => void;
}

export interface ButtonGroupHandle {
  el: HTMLDivElement;
  setPressed(id: string, pressed: boolean | undefined): void;
  setDisabled(id: string, disabled: boolean): void;
}

export interface ButtonGroupItem {
  id: string;
  /** Visible text, or the accessible name (and tooltip) of an icon-only button. */
  label: string;
  icon?: IconName | string;
  /** Show only the icon. */
  iconOnly?: boolean;
  /** Toggle buttons: sets `aria-pressed`. Leave undefined for plain action buttons. */
  pressed?: boolean;
  disabled?: boolean;
}
```

## Web example

```ts
import { createButtonGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/web';

let range = 'week';

const group = createButtonGroup({
  label: 'Range',
  items: [
    { id: 'day', label: 'Day', pressed: false },
    { id: 'week', label: 'Week', pressed: true },
    { id: 'month', label: 'Month', pressed: false },
  ],
  onClick: (id) => {
    group.setPressed(range, false);
    group.setPressed(id, true);
    range = id;
  },
});

document.body.append(group.el);
```

## React API

`ButtonGroup` (types in `dist/react/actions.d.ts`): Same DOM and classes as `createButtonGroup`. Pressed and disabled states come from `items`.

```ts
export function ButtonGroup({ items, label, variant, size, orientation = 'horizontal', toolbar = false, fullWidth, onClick, className }: ButtonGroupProps);

export interface ButtonGroupProps {
  items: readonly ButtonGroupItem[];
  /** Accessible name of the group. */
  label?: string;
  variant?: ButtonGroupVariant;
  size?: ButtonSize;
  orientation?: ButtonGroupOrientation;
  /** One tab stop; arrow keys, Home and End move between the buttons. */
  toolbar?: boolean;
  fullWidth?: boolean;
  onClick?: (id: string, event: MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => void;
  className?: string;
}
```

## React example

```tsx
import { useState } from 'react';
import { ButtonGroup } from '@mosaic-home/design-system/react';

const ranges = [
  { id: 'day', label: 'Day' },
  { id: 'week', label: 'Week' },
  { id: 'month', label: 'Month' },
];

export function ButtonGroupExample() {
  const [range, setRange] = useState('week');
  return (
    <ButtonGroup
      label="Range"
      items={ranges.map((item) => ({ ...item, pressed: item.id === range }))}
      onClick={setRange}
    />
  );
}
```
